glosses: theater (a place or building, consisting of a stage and seating, in which an audience gathers to watch plays, musical performances, public ceremonies, and so on)
theater (drama or performance as a profession or artform)

examples.text: Há um estacionamento atrás do teatro.
examples.en: There is a parking lot behind the theater.

examples.text: Como faço para chegar ao teatro?
examples.en: How do I get to the theater?
He loves going to the theater.

examples.text: A que horas vocês vão ao teatro?
examples.en: What time are you guys going to the theater?
